note: Signatureglobal (India) Ltd (NSE SIGNATURE, filing prefix SGLOBAL; BSE 543990). Standard mode: all 8 calls in the window located. Q4 FY24-Q4 FY26 transcripts are exchange-filed (NSE, company site, or BSE via Business Standard mirror where BSE returned 403); read through web-fetch text extraction (curl proxy-blocked), so quotes may differ marginally from the PDF and page numbers may be ±1. Q1 FY27 transcript read only via AlphaStreet/QuarterMark reproductions [secondary]; its outcomes taken from the NSE-filed Q1 FY27 presentation. Event grade = mean of graded item grades. De-duplication: a promise is captured once at its earliest statement; restatements folded into that item's note. FY25 guidance (pre-sales, collections, launches, revenue recognition, net-debt ratio) was first set on the Q4 FY24 call (2024-05-16), outside the 8-call window, and is graded there under Rule 7; in-window restatements are recorded but not double-scored. C5.3 applied: FY26 pre-sales guidance (INR 125 bn on calls; INR 127 bn in the 2026-01-11 KPI filing) was reaffirmed in full on 2025-11-10 with H1 at <40% of target and withdrawn 2026-01-11 alongside Q3 numbers — withdrawal after visible shortfall, scored as a miss. Launch guidance cut 170→150 bn in-period: scored against 170 bn. Spend plans (land/BD, construction) recorded, not graded. Embedded 35% EBITDA (pre-sales basis) not gradeable — no reported figure on that basis. Analyst-framed figures (FY26 revenue recognition ~INR 7,000 Cr, Q4 FY24 call) not captured. No class-10 assurance contradicted on a SEVERE issue: no override. Class 6 (tax/normalisation): none stated in any call. Recurring pattern: pre-sales guidance met in FY25 (by 3%), missed in FY26 (−34%); collections, revenue recognition and launch GDV missed in both years by 16-46%; launch timelines slipped 1-5 quarters with approvals cited; net-debt ratio ceiling held (0.54x FY25, ~0.1x FY26) but the absolute FY25 cap (INR 500-600 Cr) was breached. Open: FY27 guidance (pre-sales 100 bn, launches 150 bn, collections 50 bn, revenue 50 bn), zero net debt by Nov 2026-Feb 2027 (net debt rising: INR 3.9 bn Jun 2026). Score: 7 graded events (incl. 1 outside_window), weights 7→1: (0.75x7 + 0.67x6 + 1.5x5 + 0.5x4 + 0.5x3 + 0.0x2 + 0.83x1) / 28 x 5 = 3.768 → 3.8. Q1 FY27 and Q4 FY26 pending.
